judge.prompt_scope: Archived configuration uses target_explanation; not the final isolated-server judge configuration.

temperature.evidence: Current runner implementation; historical request value not independently logged

max_completion_tokens.evidence: Current config default; historical environment override not recovered

judge.decision: Parsed JSON pass / final_judgment; see released parser source
judge.exceptions: Current runner maps judge exceptions to fail; error records remain available per instance

memory_rules.scope: Current code snapshot; per-episode recorded memory_schema and manifests take precedence for historical runs
memory_rules.admission: Binary gate sets positive/negative polarity. Relation text and visual evidence are required; minimum confidence defaults to 0.2, plus element/attribute validation.
memory_rules.retrieval: Explicit lexical find/grep → open → select. Matches ordered by creation time and confidence; no embedding ranking.
memory_rules.polarity: Positive strategies may be reused; negative records provide warnings and repair constraints.
memory_rules.provenance: Own-task and other-task use original WISE task IDs. Analogical targets use explicit source_prompt_id; IDs are scoped to their dataset.

routing.rule: R2 and R3 rerun previous strict-judge failures. Unchanged images are carried forward; gate labels are not substituted for official scores.

search_audit.scope: Recorded text queries/results and reference-image provenance in imported episodes
search_audit.screen: Known benchmark markers and exact 12-word spans from WISE prompts/explanations; query headers excluded from result matching.
search_audit.status: Automated screening completed; manual adjudication and clean reruns pending
search_audit.interpretation: Leakage through live search is not established. A fingerprint hit is a review candidate, not proof. No hit is not proof of absence.
search_audit.qualification: Imported results use open-web evaluation. No benchmark-isolated retrieval guarantee is claimed.
